lokele: Imi Paulo Botomomu wa Masiya Yesu ko la lisangi lia Mungu, eoka ya lisakä lia loiko elosoomana la Masiya Yesu,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ 1:1 through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

lokele: ende Timoteo wana wami wa losamɔ; booto la shota la lilatemi lia Mungu Sango la Masiya Yesu Ngɛnɛ wasu biyaleke laɛ. Kelekele ya Paulo eoka ya lilendelu lia Timoteo
english: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

lokele: Itofaekefa Mungu kelekëlë ani itoenyakela’aɛ mbile la mbile nda basomboli bami ende Mungu oyasokuwela’mi okuwel’Inde la botema botanu, kwa akelaka imɔ bangau bami.
english: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

lokele: La ocho la löwa, ani atoenyakela’mi foo yaɛ eyɛnɛnɛk’iso laɛ, itokwelo yɛmɛ yɔɛnɛ aɛ liasi, mbo iyaleke ko la limɛngɔ fuu liasi.
english: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

lokele: Isoenyelesomo loasɔ loa lilendelu liaɛ lia momongo, lia bɔfɔnɔ ewayalaka oso la tata waɛ otomali, ako Loisi la elia nyango waɛ ako Euniki la iluwi nde mbo liyali imɔ ko laɛ.
english: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

lokele: Ko l’eokao itoenyakeles’aɛ ndofumbesa isosha sha booto eshafomoko aɛ la Mungu ko la lotalio loa besamba yami;
english: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

lokele: eoka Mungu atiafaefak’iso bolimo wa bɔwa, kangä ewa bofoka la losamɔ la likɔmɔnyi lia botema.
english: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

lokele: Eokao owëke limama nda linangoli loasɔ loa Ngɛnɛ wasu, ango ko eoka yami oyakandakcmu bɔnyɔlɔlɔ eoka yande, kongo ko aelaka likaɔ lia biale ebitookak’iso eoka ya Mboli Ilau, ko la bofoka wa Mungu,
english: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

lokele: oyasouwes’iso, oyasot’iso lioi lia lotanesomo, inga eoka ya bekeeli yasu, kangä eoka ya lisangi liande angɛnɛ la booto wande ewafomoko iso ende Masiya Yesu ko oso wa lotango loa mbile,
english: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

lokele: ebosoisoelomo iso kwani ko la lɔɛnɛlɔ loa Bouwesi wasu ako Masiya Yesu oyasotungamesa liwa la oyasoanesa loiko la liwawi elitilafɔndɛk’imɔ, ko l’eoka ya Mboli Ilau.
english: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

lokele: La imi nd’atomokö bonangoli la Botomomu la boekesi,
english: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

lokele: ko l’eokao isokaka imɔ ko biale-bi. Nde itioke sɔni eoka iluwi nde ndoluw’Inde oyasolendokolomo lami la iluwi nde mbo asokɔkɔlɔ ndotingakana la yao ebisofaefa’mi efaef’inde ko nda lise lina lia Ngɛnɛ.
english: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

lokele: Tutelaka ko eluweselo ya liekesi lilau elisok’aɛ ende’mi ko la lilendelu la losamɔ loa Masiya Yesu;
english: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

lokele: tinganaka la wɛlï la yao ya wewe ebisofaefomo aɛ ko la Bolimo Botanu oyayali atiteni yasu.
english: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

lokele: Osoluwa loasɔ loko mbo baina batotina nda tukela ya Asia basolɔmwɛlɛ’mi, bu ko la Fungelo la Elumongene amamwito lau.
english: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

lokele: Ngɛnɛ wasu awɛlɛkɛ bofindi wa Onesifolo shota eoka inde nd’asoyasunga’mi mbile la mbile la atiokele bɔnyɔlɔlɔ wami sɔni,
english: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

lokele: nde iyak’inde nda Loma, inde lumama okaluke’mi la inde loosha’mi omao.
english: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

lokele: Ngɛnɛ wasu afek’inde fofe yoosha shota sha Ngɛnɛ nda lise lina liande; la lisungi liande nda Efeso, aɛ nd’aluwi liao finɛ.
english: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

lokele: Aɛ, wana wami, wangemesomoko ko la booto ebole la Masiya Yesu,
english: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

lokele: la yao ebisokak’aɛ ende’mi nda baiso ba batangeli wike, ɔlɛsɛkɛ imɔ ko bato basi ebolendelomo mbo baekekeseke imɔ ko basi.
english: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

lokele: Aelaka likaɔ lia biale ebitokak’iso kwa bosilikani bolau wa Masiya Yesu.
english: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

lokele: Bosilikani oyasɔkɛ bita aitoluwan’imɔ la njasɔ ya okenge eoka mbo aomaleseke Komanda oyasotak’inde lina nda lotango.
english: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

lokele: La boto wa liangɔ imɔ, aitofomo ikëmbë sha ngɔi sakolo ngo ko asolitesa baiti ba liangɔ.
english: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

lokele: Bokuwi wa elanga oyatokaka bonui, aondu nde ndɔɔlɔ eula ya elanga oso wa basi.
english: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

lokele: Enyakelaka elotoonga’mi la Ngɛnɛ wasu atolembeeles’aɛ litina litotina.
english: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

lokele: Enyakelaka Yesu Masiya wa bofindi wa Dawidi, oyatɛmwɛsɔmɔkɔ nda liwa, kwa asoekesomo nda Mboli Ilau ebisonangola’mi;
english: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring 2:8 of David, according to my Good News,

lokele: la eoka ya Mboli Ilau-bi isoka biale oko kwani asokandomo’mi bɔnyɔlɔlɔ kwa oto obe finɛ, kongo ko Lioi lia Mungu litikandomo.
english: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

lokele: Eokao isotendela bitotina mbo ebasoaomo la Mungu, baɔlɛkɛ imɔ ko liuwesi elisoomana la Masiya Yesu ko la tala ya layalaya lisanga.
english: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

lokele: Liölo-li lile ngo ko wewe, mbo— Eya to mbo tosowa amamwito la Masiya, ambo tolayalanaka lande nda loiko;
english: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

lokele: Eya mbo tokɔkɔmɛlɛ biale, tolaɔlɔkɔ likaɔ nda yakakaelo yande. Toanganya Inde, ani Inde elaanganyaka iso;
english: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

lokele: Eya mbo iso toti bolendelomo, Inde angɛnɛ asokɔkɔmɔ ewolendelomo, eoka atikɔkɔlɛ ndotombola lioi liande angɛnɛ.
english: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

lokele: Enyelesaka iyo njasɔ-bi. Nda baiso ba Ngɛnɛ telak’iyo imɔ liti mbo bafenyakanëke tofenya twa baoi, eoka ongoma twao angosunga loasɔ, kangä koeyaeyesaka ebatoka liekesi.
english: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

lokele: Fumbaka la bofiili ndoɛnɛlɛ oso wa Mungu kwa bokuwi oyatoomalesa ngɛnɛ wande, angoka sɔni nda bokalala wa lioi lia wewe eoka atosanoela lioi la liengani.
english: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

lokele: Fekaka to beongaonga la tofenya ebile wawa eoka ongoma batokɛkɛ la oso nda litefoli lia njasɔ ya Mungu, la baoi bau batokɔnɔ kwa loo nda Etanda.
english: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

lokele: Humanayo la Fileto bale bato ba bɔfɔnɔ-bo,
english: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

lokele: basolota nda mboka ya wewe ani basoonga mbo litɛmwi nda liwa lisosila oko kwani, la ongoma basoeyaeyesa lilendelu lia bato bamɔi.
english: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

lokele: Kongo ko esukameselo eyekɔkɔmu, eyaswomokö ko la Mungu ekoyali ina la esotomo ndembe ya chapa yande, mbo— Ngɛnɛ nd’aluwi ebande; la imɔ mbo— Boto la boto oyatosingwa Lina lia Ngɛnɛ asɛnyanɛkɛ la bitotina ebitiengane.
english: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” Numbers 16:5 and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord 2:19 depart from unrighteousness.”

lokele: Nda ndakɔ ya likama, biɛngɔ ina biti ko eya mbela la bieto ya pata kongo, kangä imɔ ko eya tosandu la tɔlɔngɔ, la bimɔi bile yotaliomo nda likuwa, la ebimɔi biti yotaliomo.
english: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

lokele: Eya to mbo boto etanesa botema wande ndosokola ebimɔi, inde koyala kwa ɛɛngɔ yotaliomo, eyesüchomo la eyengani nde la likuwa lia ngɛnɛ wa ndakɔ la eyekɔmɔnyɔmu bakuwa batotina balau.
english: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

lokele: Kwelaka to yɛmɛ ya liemba botili, nde engaka liengani, la lilendelu, la losamɔ, la lilatemi amamwito l’ebatosingwaka lina lia Ngɛnɛ ko la betema betanu.
english: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

lokele: Fekaka ndoka tofenya la bosho wa bibebe eoka bile wawa la oluwi nde mbo bitofɔɔlɔ liwesani kongo.
english: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

lokele: Nde bɔkɔwa wa Ngɛnɛ wasu ationdu nde ndowesakana, kangä ndoyala boto wa shɔnjɔnja ende batotina la boekesi wa wɛlï la bɔfɔɔmu.
english: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

lokele: aekeseke ko la botema sambo ebatotefokol’inde, eluwa Mungu atofaef’iyo fofe yokalangana la yoluwa njasɔ ya wewe,
english: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

lokele: la mbo buwesomoko see nda ilonga sha Satana esisoundes’iyo kakau mbo bakeleke lisangi liande.
english: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

lokele: Luwaka nde mbo nda bacho ba liili, mbile biwaü finɛ bilayaka.
english: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

lokele: Eoka bato belayalaka la yɛmɛ ya njasɔ yau angɛnɛ kongo, la yɛmɛ ya bieto wike, tofäalä, bɔmɛtɔ, ebatosɛɔlɔ basi, ebaitolitesa ebaot’iyo, ebati la bootaota, ebati la boyaeli botanu,
english: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

lokele: ebati la booto, la angwɛnɛ liwa-ngandi, eba tomwatomwa, ebatiluwe ndofekela yɛmɛ yau, ebale la bolengi wa nyama, ebatilɛmbɛ bolau,
english: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

lokele: ebatowamba baina, eba bofaofao nda njasɔ, ebatofaala la bɔfɛnɔ, ebasami ko bamɛngɔ nde batisame Mungu,
english: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

lokele: batokweela boyaeli wa basemoli ba Mungu, nde batoanganya bofoka wande nda betema. Taka to bɔfɔnɔ-bo w’ato bɔkɔngɔ!
english: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

lokele: Bamɔi bau batɔɔndɔkɔkɔ ndokaɔtɔ nda ndakɔ mbo baɔngɔlɛkɛ totomali etosokaka bolito wa njasɔ ibe, la etosofɛfɛ la yɛmɛ ya bɛfɔnɔ wike,
english: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

lokele: ebatoekaeka liekeëlä, angokɔkɔlɔ ndoosha liluwani lia wewe ango sinyo.
english: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

lokele: Kwa afekwanaka nde Yane la Yambele ofekwana la Mose, ko ongoma, e-bato-ba batofekwana njasɔ ya wewe; betema yau bisobeba la obe la bati boimelomo nda njasɔ ya lilendelu.
english: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

lokele: Kongoko baitolonga ndɔkɛ la oso eoka bibebe yau bitoluwana la batotina kwa ayalak’imɔ loasɔ loa bato ana kwaala.
english: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

lokele: Nde aɛ Timoteo, osotuta liekesi liami la wɛlï, boyaeli wami, la yao ebisosangaka’mi, lilendelu liami, liombakeli liami angowa esole, losamɔ loami, la likɔkɔmɛlɛ liami,
english: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

lokele: la likongolomu la biale eyokaka’mi, la nda Antiokia la nda Ikonio la Lusetula. Aina bakongolomu ebokaka’mi! Nde Ngɛnɛ lɔɔnɔkɔlɔkɔ’mi nda bao batotina fɛɛ.
english: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

lokele: Eingo ko, batotina ebasangi ndoyalaka la lilitesi lia Mungu ko la Masiya Yesu nda liwawi-li, bekongolomoko nde;
english: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

lokele: kongo ko bato babe la balimbakeli batokaetama nda obe, batolimbaka la batolimbokomo imɔ.
english: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

lokele: Nde aɛ angɛnɛ, kɔkɔmɔkɔ nda yao ebisoek’aɛ la ebisoimel’aɛ mbo yende wewe ani asoluwak’aɛ bato ebasoekekes’aɛ,
english: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

lokele: la mbo, ko nda shainɛngɛ shaɛ osoluwa Kasa ya Mungu ebisokɔkɔlɔ ndɔɔlɛs’aɛ liluwani lia lilendelu liolendelo Masiya Yesu.
english: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

lokele: Lokasa lototina losotomo ko la Bolimo wa Mungu la loondu nde ndosungak’iso nda liekesi lilau, la nda boimo la litomboli lia yao ebiti wewe la ndokɔsɔlɔ ebale kwa bainɛngɛ nda liengani,
english: Every Scripture is God-breathed and 3:16 profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

lokele: mbo Boto wa Mungu aɔlweke hɔlɔɔ ani asosungomo ndokela bakuwa balau batotina.
english: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

lokele: Isotel’aɛ likakanelo nda baiso ba Mungu la Masiya Yesu oyatoatakela ebakoyala la liwawi, l’ebasowa; ko la loyo loande la Bɔkɔta wande,
english: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

lokele: taka boeki wa Lioi liande; emaelaka likuwa liaɛ la nda mbile ya fofe, l’ani fofe etiɛnɛlɛ, imakaka, faka liɛngɔ, fumbesaka, owëke esole ango sinyo nda liekesi liaɛ.
english: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

lokele: Eoka mbile elayaka nde eyetiokeke bato liekesi lia wewe, kongo ko, l’eoka ya yɛmɛ yau angɛnɛ, batotaka likama lia baekesi lioi eoka batoi bau angɛnɛ bende la longo lokaka njasɔ biyai,
english: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

lokele: la batoimbokola batoi bau nda liekesi lia wewe la batokatute bembila ya batata.
english: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

lokele: Nde aɛ angɛnɛ, aekesaka botema se, tendekelaka biale, kelaka likuwa lia Bonangoli wa Mboli Ilau, ɔlɔlɔkɔ lotimbana loaɛ loa bosungi. Mboli ya Paulo la baina omolo ayali Paulo
english: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

lokele: Nde loasɔ loami angɛnɛ, Imi ikowɛlɔmɔ se, kwa lifaefi elisowɛlɛmɛ se nda etambelo la mbile ya lɔkɛndɔ loami losamboiya;
english: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

lokele: isolonga ndonana liango lilau, isoiya la lilongi nda fɔmbi, isokɔcha tele yami ya lilendelu;
english: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

lokele: ko la mbile eyekayeke iyoyo sha bowangɔ sisüchelomo’mi; la Ngɛnɛ wasu elafaka’mi shao nda lise lina liande, Inde nd’ale Bokomyi ewengani. Tinga’mi angɛnɛ kongo, kangä imɔ ko batotina ebasolombakela loyo loande la losamɔ, iyo belafomoko imɔ ko shao.
english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

lokele: Fumbaka ndoya ende’mi lisasaya,
english: Be diligent to come to me soon,

lokele: eoka Dema, oyasami nde njasɔ ya wenda-bo, asomacha’mi okakɛ nda Tesalonika; Kelesekene asɔkɛ nda Galatia la Tito nda Dalamatia.
english: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

lokele: Ko Luka kongo ayali lami ono; taosoko Malako, yauku lande amamwito laɛ, eoka asosunga’mi la lotimbana nda likuwa.
english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

lokele: Isotoma Tukiko nda Efeso.
english: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

lokele: Eyekayek’aɛ, eshaka kanjo eyamachaka’mi olo eya Kalapo nda Tuloa la kasa ina imɔ, nde simbi to kofo yosɔnɛlɔmɔ kasa.
english: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

lokele: Alesandelo botuli wa mbela asotamba’mi bokondo finɛ; Ngɛnɛ elaolɛsɛk’inde likundo lioengana la bekeeli yande.
english: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

lokele: Aɛ imɔ kolamb’inde la wɛlï eoka afekelak’iso inango finɛ;
english: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

lokele: Boto angɔmɔi ationgele’mi nda limutoli liami lia oso liomutola liwanjelomu, nde batotina bamacheliki’mi; lotatangelomo iyo mbo loasɔ!
english: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

lokele: Nde Ngɛnɛ wasu ayalanaka lami ndɔɔlɛsɛ’mi bofoka, mbo ko lami linangoli lia wɛndi wande limelesomoko nda wenda la mbo tukela ya bato batotina bokeke wao; la isɔɔnɔkɔlɔmɔ nda bɔnɔkɔ wa simba,
english: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

lokele: Ngɛnɛ wasu atɔɔnɔkɔlɔ’mi nda bobe bototina la atouwesa’mi yɔtɛkɛ nda Bɔkɔta wande wa Use. Ataliomoko tala ko layalaya, ongoma. Baseeli ende baina ba Paulo
english: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

lokele: Seelelaka’mi Pulisika la Akwila la bofindi wa Onesifolo.
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

lokele: Elaseto asotikala nda Kolinto la isomacha Tulofimo nda Mileto ani ayali la loo.
english: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

lokele: Fumbaka ndoya ono oso wa tengai ya bondiya. Eubulu asoseel’aɛ, la Pudeno la Lino la Kalaudia la bitungani bitotina ya Etanda imɔ basoseelak’aɛ.
english: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

lokele: Ngɛnɛ wasu ayaleke la bolimo waɛ. Booto boyaleke lanu.
english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
